summary: preinstall drops Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundled payload
details: @ornikar/eslint-config-babel-use@13.2.10 declares scripts.preinstall as `node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs downloads a Bun binary from `https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/` into a temp directory, marks it executable, and invokes it against a bundled 727KB single-line obfuscated file `math_init.js` (obfuscator.io-style numeric string-array + `WV8StW` rotator decoder, `// @bun @bun-cjs` header). The obfuscated payload therefore runs automatically on `npm install`. An ESLint config package has no legitimate need to fetch a second language runtime and execute a large opaque sibling module at install time; the actual ESLint config lives in a tiny `index.js`. The scope and repository name mirror the legitimate `@ornikar` scope, but the install-time behavior is inconsistent with prior versions of ornikar's ESLint configs, indicating a hijack/typosquat release rather than legitimate maintainer work.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
